name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-CNC
notes: High-level CNC cell coordinator. It normalizes read-only controller evidence and can now query real GRBL status and send GRBL's own real-time control bytes (status query, feed hold, cycle resume, soft reset) over a real serial connection; LinuxCNC or another controller retains real-time trajectory, limits, spindle and safety authority - this never streams a G-code program.
